purpose: What each source establishes about Kairos Campus, and what it does not. Only statements listed under 'establishes' were treated as canon by the model.

establishes: Campus is in Los Angeles, California
Visual direction: private gaming mansion or residential esports compound, not a college
A separate League of Legends building
A separate Counter-Strike building
Shared operational areas and shared performance resources
Space reserved for future esports divisions
Campus supports training, coaching, analytics, health, performance, content, administration
Project Casa Arthur was a conditional plan (Episode 54): one bedroom, living room, kitchen, garden
By Episode 86 Arthur lives in the campus residential area; whether a separate Casa Arthur was built is TBD
Recreation Center operates by Episode 86, for rest and wellbeing, not a public arena
Food-service policy: three chains selected for invitations and negotiations only; nothing built or signed

List of confirmed-function areas: Adrian's office, media/interview, LoL Main/Black, Academy Blue, Academy White rooms, CS Main and Academy rooms, the five Commons rooms, accessible family-residential zone
does_not_establish: any placement or geometry; everything else in the file is marked proposed-layout

sources.title: Fora do Servidor (2026-12-13)
establishes: Recreation Center is a new building between the dormitories and the performance center
Not an arena; no public stands; no intention to host competitions
Covered multi-sport court: basketball, futsal, volleyball
Two table-tennis tables beside it
A smaller stretching and mobility area
After the corridor, the gym that already existed in the performance program, now directly connected
Arthur Fletcher lives in an accessible campus residence

sources.title: Mais do Que Jogadores (2027-01-12)
establishes: Kairos Commons opens in the west wing, for all 25 players of both divisions and their coaches
Maker Lab: large benches, tools, disassembled computers, electronics kits, soldering station, 3D printing space, cabinets still empty, wall sign MAKER LAB
Next room: acoustic treatment, large digital piano, two guitars, bass, electronic drum kit, microphones, small recording desk
Then the image room: cameras, lenses, editing computers, lighting, small neutral backdrop; no large Kairos logo; publishing is voluntary
Then the kitchen: much smaller than the professional dining-hall kitchen, but complete: counter, stove, oven, refrigerator, utensils, cabinets
Outdoor area: multipurpose court, half basketball court, space for futsal, small smooth strip usable for skating, tables, covered area; nothing gigantic or professional; skateboards kept in a cabinet
At the end of the corridor: a small, almost office-like room with a whiteboard, sign KAIROS COMMUNITY
A main room ('sala principal') where the group gathers
Rules: no performance metrics, no content requirement
Training rooms are called 'sala preta' and 'sala azul'; a dining hall ('refeitório') with a professional kitchen exists
does_not_establish: which side of the corridor rooms are on
what the wing is west of
